company_info.company_description: "The team at Green Sky Solar bring together many years’ experience, to ensure that we deliver the results you need. Whether it’s a solar PV System, Battery, or EV charger, we’ve got proven experience.Unlike some competitors, our focus is not on getting the most money out of you, it is on delivering the result that you require.We all spend a lot of our lives working, so we figure you’ve got to enjoy what you do, and always have fun. Right?! The Green Sky Solar team love to help people. We enjoy assisting our clients with their needs before, during, and after their installation. Don’t be afraid to email or call us and speak with one of our friendly team members.We believe that all of our business dealings should be win/win. If both parties aren’t happy, what’s the point? We constantly strive to deliver the best for our clients. Happy customers breed happy customers, and at Green Sky Solar, we pride ourselves on the many referrals we receive.In August 2024 we decided it was time to refresh our logo and our name. We are still 'Green Sky', but now we are 'Green Sky Solar' instead of 'Green Sky Australia'."

reviews.review_description: Good to support local business.Sales staff was helpful without being forceful.Installation went as planned.Tidy and courteous workers.Waiting for inspection and activation.I thought all would be connected and ready to go on completion of installation.

Quick response to my request for a quote.Asked lots of question and site visit to ensure the best system for my needs.Time to installation was short.The tradies on the day were friendly and professional.Cleaned up after job and explained everything for me.

Green Sky Solar are soon to instal a 10.45 kw system. Matt's knowledge and manner plus all the info on Solar Quotes made the process of comparing and weighing up all the aspects pretty good. It was a tough choice between suppliers. It came down to product quality even though there is probably not much difference. I felt good working through it all and arriving at a confident decision.

From the start, excellent response with site visit, quoted options, follow-up, quick response to questions. Then an efficient team turning up on time, and completing the job with minimum fuss and with courtesy.Some small items needed attention : cleaning-up was not done in both spots, just one, leaving brick dust next to the front door. And the PV sticker was not attached to the meter box. However, a team member returned the next day to check on some lights that didn't work after the switchboard work may[?] have disturbed existing wiring. Those small items were fixed the following day.I could have received more assistance with the app. but assistance was available via email with quick response.

Best hard working Installing crew around who really enjoy their work and got the job done in time and also cleaned up their mess afterwards.Great communication and service also from the office. Can only highly recommend this company.

Green Sky Solar have provided exceptional service. The sales team were professional,  the installers have been polite, punctual and efficient, and while we are still waiting for the certification,  the experience so far has been great.

We have been very happy with Green Sky.The sales guy was honest and realistic about what we needed and didn’t just sell us the most expensive system.The installers did a great job and were very flexible with us (we took some holidays during the process and they were Ok to work around our plans)Miri at the office was always helpful.The system is working really well. We have no energy costs (not using heating or cooling at this time) except for small charges on cloudy days when charging the EV.Very happy. Thanks for the referral.

Sales/quoting was after a personal visit by Manny rather than a tele hook-up from other firm. Asked them to round the quote down to $7K which was accepted. My complicated house meant they took over a day to install. All very neat without broken tiles, everything fully explained. They organised the inspection and connection. My only concern is two periods of no generation in the first two weeks, both self resolving within hours. I hope this not a weakness in the inverter.

I had been researching the whole solar scenario on & off since 2016. Didn't suit us until we retired. Very happy I discovered Finn Peacock & SolarQuotes that led me to Green Sky Australia in Carrum Downs Vic, I couldn't be happier. So pleased I waited till there was more Govt $$ to subsidise. Brad, Matt & Pat were great to have around, total pros & such a neat & compliant job! Miri in the office super efficient & Manny was no pressure sales. Facts speak for themselves. Very happy here in Frankston South. Cheers Amanda

System specification and quotation process was terrific.  Very responsive and excellent communication.  The quote documentation was comprehensive but easy to understand and enabled an informed purchase decision.  Manny Singh made the quotation process a breeze.  Installers arrive on time and were super efficient.  Cannot fault them on their attention to detail, consideration and the excellent quality of the work that they did.  Every aspect of the installation looks neat, professional and of high quality.  There was a requirement to move the battery once it had been installed and I was really impressed with how quickly this was done.  No quibble and no fuss; the team came back on site; disconnected, moved and reconnected the battery with no fuss and the result is as neat and as professional as I could ever want.  I was really impressed how they did this extra work at no cost and without any hesitation.  Based on my experience I have no hesitation recommending this excellent business, and I will definitely be calling them first if and when I continue my solar journey!
A knowledgeable company to deal with, from the initial sales enquiry, through to installation, and follow up.

We chose Green Sky Australia, a local provider to the Mornington Peninsula, great service, at my request they rechecked the panels last week after a huge wind storm overnight, it was all ok, the noises were not the panels, very reassuring. Also the salesman Manny Singh had an eye for detail and explained the issues to us. The admin staff at Green Sky respond quickly to any enquirers and same for the Enphase help line for the app.System:6.6kw microinverter PV system, export limited to 5kva, for grid connection.15 x 440w panels on north roof. 1 string of 10 panels and 1 string of 5 panels.Voc 58.4/58.4v Isc 10.6/10.6a New pre made solar DB installed at main switchboard.New 32a main switch inverter supply in switchboard.List of equipment:15 Trina TSM-440NEG9R.28 panels and 15 Enphase IQ8AC-72-M-INT microinverters, 1 Enphase pre made Solar DB incorporating circuit breakers and envoy and 1 32a circuit breaker Clenergy racking and mounts.My advice to new customers- solar is complex to understand, as there are so many things to know, take your time- multiple panels to consider and same for inverters- basically there are 2 systems, an DC system with a single "String Inverter" located at the switchboard or an AC system on your roof with small inverters called “Microinverters" located on each panel on the roof- DC electricity vs AC electricity on your roof is worth understanding and learning about- ask lots of questions and become familiar with this info- everything I learned about batteries indicated to me they were really only an option for off grid set ups where you must have a battery and or a generator backup, and there are fire risks to consider when locating a battery system, I am not a fan of current batteries (lithium)- it would be good if the installers could also advise about generator backup options, to me that would be better than a battery and could make you more independent of the grid, just for interest, as a backup system instead of a battery or the grid- Solar Quotes has been very helpful, I recommend this serviceImpression- we did ok on price and system, I had a preference for an AC system on my roof, I think its safer- the provider I got independently was nearly double the price of SolarQuotes providers quotesThanksTony

Excellent office administration. Timelines and processes worked seamlessly, reminders about next steps for rebates and all certificates to be signed etc.Great install, on time and professional.6 months in.. minor glitches quickly sorted by company. Hands on manager, great team operation.
Very impressed. The installers were prompt, efficient, happy and extremely tidy. They cleaned up immaculately. The admin team also very efficient and helpful.

The Company was extremely easy to deal with. Sales/quotation process was very simple and transparent. The installation was completed on the nominated date and the installers were very good. The Solar transition was very easy.

Manny and the admin team at Green Sky were very helpful and accommodating through the quotation process. They were happy to take my calls and answer my questions.  After a site inspection, I was comfortable enough to sign on with them for one of the systems they had designed to meet my requirements.The installation was scheduled and completed on time, on the agreed upon dates.  Everything installed is very neatly put together and looks to be of a very high standard.  My property was left completely clear of any debris, nothing was damaged.  In fact not even a roof tile was damaged during the installation.My system has now been running for around three weeks and is performing above my expectations for Melbourne's winter season.  I look forward to seeing how it performs during the warmer months.I'm a very happy customer.  Thanks Green Sky!

The company was very profession from the outset, they provided a through quote, explained the system, offered a competitive price and then came and installed it properly. I cant recommend them highly enough.

Matt explained everything very well. The guys who did the install were very good. The installation is very neat and was very well explained to me. After one day I am very happy with it. I am sure I will get the benefits for many years to come.

It may be too early to tell but if I had my time again i would have opted for the bigger batterySales quotation was pleasant ,felt the representative was listening to us and not pushy.Installation was soon after order placed, problem with initial connection which was quickly rectified.Greenskies customer service handled everything , very easy project.

Sales and quoting polite and not pushy, Explained everything well.Installation  was done by B J White on behalf of Green Sky.Their work was excellent, arrived on time, friendly workers, happy to explain things.Did a neat job, left everything tidy. Spent time getting the WiFi monitoring going.Happy to recommend these people.
Everything was well explained and executed in a friendly and professional manner from sales, administration and installation.

Mani the sales guy was great.No BS just the facts.The installers obviously know their stuff and did not trample the garden.The entire job was Q Cells panels , inverter and battery and boy does it look good !!Q Cells stuff just looks so much more pro than any other stuff I have seen. I feel confident that I have made a good decision here and the 15/20 year warranty just adds more piece of mind.
The quotation process was informative and the installation team was punctual and clear and open on what they were doing.They organised the approval of the installation and connection to the grid.

I selected Green Sky  bc they requested more information about my lifestyle and the data on my bills before suggested the best battery options for me. They were then responsive to my questions. I wanted to access daytime storage if a blackout occurred during daylight hours. The installers are punctual, professional and neat. They ran me through the mechanisms and reading app. The inspector came the next day.

Manny from Green Sky listened to my needs and gave me options to suit and he and the office staff were helpful whenever I had any questions.  The price was very competitive and the whole process was easy.Installation was timely and the crew were punctual, neat and tidy and discussed the install with me; I was very impressed.
Great customer service. Easy install, everyone very friendly.Managed to install before Christmas.

Green Sky were great from the outset - I dealt with the same salesperson throughout the process, and he even did a site visit to talk me through the system and process (the other two companies from which I received quotes would only visit once I accepted their quotes). The system itself was well-priced, and the installers were punctual and quite fast. They also communicated around turning off the power, knowing that I was working from home. Highly recommend this company!

Quotes took some sorting out as most companies are keen to “ Cookie Cutter” their quotes. Finally got Greensky to come out and discuss our needs and concerns. They managed to get closest to our requested size although disappointingly the installers had to drop a panel of the system due to area constraints. Overall however the discussions over size and cost were productive. The installation was very well done even though there were a few minor hiccups. Have just paid system in full and waiting for inspection so we can fully embrace our solar powered future.

I'm thrilled to share my incredibly positive experience with Green Sky Solar Company. From the very beginning, the team provided a level of service that went above and beyond my expectations. They took the time to understand my specific needs and consequently tailored a solar system that was the perfect fit for me.The punctuality of the team was commendable; they arrived exactly as scheduled, which truly showcased their respect for my time. I was also impressed by the professionalism of their installers. Their expertise was evident in the quality of their work, and it reassured me that my project was in the hands of people who truly know what they're doing.Most importantly, Green Sky made the entire process absolutely hassle-free. I was initially worried about the complexities involved in installing a solar system, but their team seamlessly managed everything, leaving me stress-free. This is a testament to their superb project management skills and customer service.I highly recommend Green Sky to anyone considering a switch to solar energy. They are a trustworthy and competent company that delivers an unparalleled solar installation experience. I am very satisfied with their service and believe they are an excellent choice for anyone in need of a solar solution.

From day one, since I met Matt from Green Sky Australia who, came home and spoke to me, he showed not only in-depth knowledge but also very helpful and suggested the right system.During the entire pre-sales process through to installation which got completed today, his and the team's responses were prompt, polite and professional.Can't wait for system activation and thereafter, see the sustainability benefits of Solar and also e-Mobility!I would certainly recommend Green Sky Australia.Thanks again to Matt and the entire team.
Sales process was very straight forward and very knowledgeableInstallers were very polite and punctual .all necessary paperwork was initiated by installer.
Good price wanted an inexpensive system for business- appears a good quality system for the price. Installers appeared very competent.

Manny was happy to talk through the system and made me feel comfortable they knew their products.Installed in a timely manner, and their installers were high quality.Would have liked a bit more info about timeliness and process. There are a lot of entities involved, usually it's smooth.We had a config issue with the inverter and they fixed it very quickly.Would recommend them.

The salesman was polite, knowledgable and professional. Provided good advice based on our particular building orientation and design. Came on site, inspected property. Very professional.The installation team were on time, efficient and friendly. Provided ongoing information during the installation, very experienced and polite crew.The customer service was prompt and efficient, also friendly with sound advice provided.Well done Green Sky.

Extremely helpful throughout the whole process sales process was very straightforward and not pushy, installation they where on time very polite and cleaned up after themselves and helpful with all my questions. To deal with the company direct was so easy as they were more than happy to help in any way  ,will highly recommend them to everyone.
Found Green Sky from quotation to installation very professional doing a really good job.It will be even better when the scaffolding comes down.Peter.

I was very happy with the two quotes I was given.Everything happened very promptly.Installation was punctual and tidy.Customer service was excellent. I had trouble with my battery rebate forms but I was helped through them. They organised the grid connection after the install. I would highly recommend this company.

I am extremely happy with the experience of dealing with Green Sky Australia. Every interaction with them from the salesman to installation to admin has been effortless and positive.After delivering a draft proposal, I said “Nah… I want a bigger system” because I knew my roof would be a challenge and there is a massive tree obscuring half of the west side of the house for most of the afternoon. They managed to squeeze 19 panels on (16 in the draft), avoiding the tree, so now I get as much benefit from the sun my roof and trees will allow.I was also truly amazed that they managed to get the whole thing up and operational in a day. I was expecting this to take a couple of days at least. And almost immediately, on the first moderately sunny day, I’m generating twice the power I am using, and that was with air conditioning, washer, dryer and dishwasher all going! Such a good outcome! Now if the retailer would just hurry up with processing my feed-in tariff request!

The proposals received were all of high quality, GreenSky’s was very detailed and provided several options. Components offered were similar in all proposals, better value was offered by GreenSky.Communication was good, my installation date was brought forward when there was an opportunity. Installers were polite and punctual and put in a big day to get everything done. Very happy with the neatness and quality of work which is of a high standard and gives me a lot of confidence in the durability of the system. Follow up has been good, expecting grid connection in the next week.

The Green Sky team were very helpfuland responsive - from Manny the sales rep who came out to our houses quickly and was very knowledgeable and always available to handle questions, to Narelle in Admin and to the install team, everyone at Green Sky was professional and placed a high value on customer service and satisfaction. They may not have been the cheapest quote but I am happy with the quality of the product, the install and the service and so feel I got value for money.

Highly professional at all stages. Inspected site and provided a quote same day. Answered questions promptly. Installed with minimal disruption. A neat installation with no mess left behind. System performs beautifully.

Great company to work with. Salesman, installers and back office were responsive, punctual and professional. For example, before I signed up, I expressed concerns that the roof material may make installation harder, and within an hour one of their installers was on the roof to inspect it. There are cheaper options, but I feel that the smooth process and confidence that the company would resolve any issues that may arise in the future makes it worth it. Highly recommend.

From the time of quote to installation Green Sky we’re a professional company to deal with they answered all my questions. Keep me informed well during installation and we’re ever so tidy in clean up.Can’t go wrong in dealing with this company

Of the three companies that I engaged with, Green Sky were the only ones that sent a sales person to my home as part of the quoting process, and the only ones that listened to me and provided a solution that met my criteria. The entire process with them was quite seamless, of a good standard and their service was very good.

I was very happy with the whole process from quotation, to ordering and installation of my Solar panels using Green Sky Australia. Installation occured in 1 day only, without much disruption at all to our household. I was happy with how discreet the istallation is, with no exposed conduit visible. Panel wiring all done in roofspace, with wiring down to the Enphase Micros Inverters "Envoy" box (mounted on exterior wall) running behind brickwork inside the brick-vener wall.The only small hiccup was getting the Enphase Microinverters to report power usage via the Enlighten app. Initially we needed to buy a booster to connect the Envoy box with our WiFi, but connection problem persisted. To Green Sky's credit, they came back twice until the system was working corrcetly, and we have had no problems since with this application.
Great communication. Answered all my questions up front. The process was smooth. And the installation team was friendly and very professional. Would highly recommend.

Had my system installed in August 2020, left it a good while before writing this review to see how the system performed. It's been great. Keith from GreenSky was superb - I did extensive research and he was the only one prepared to come out and do a site visit and discuss the best options for my particular site.Install was smooth, but I was a little wary of the amount of work the apprentice did, and got worried when i saw them storing kit on top of the solar panels in the truck.Overall, the install job was completed with minimal fuss, and a very short outage in supply.
From Keith in sales through to Narelle in admin and Brad and his installation team they we very professional. The process went without a hiccup.
Great to deal with CAN DO people from start to finish.Everything ran smoothly.Would highly recommend Green Sky.

From the very first contact with Green Sky they were helpful and friendly. They explained all the processes involved and the types of systems they have giving us 3 options to choose from. The installers did a very neat job and the electrical inspection was carried out almost immediately after installation so the solar is now ready to benefit from.I have no hesitation in recommending Green Sky for solar installations.

From the start Green Sky were easy to work with, helpful, informative and courteous.The installation appeared to be professional and neat even though our roof was fairly steep. The after sales and installation communications were friendly and informative.I would definitely recommend this company for a solar installation.
Quote was informative and helpfulInstallation was both tidy punctualThey tried to get a grid connection but we were knocked back by Ausnet

Keith Buxton submitted a detailed quote for a 13.26KW budget system and one for a marginally better system utilising SolarEdge inverter and optimizers followed by a site visit.Keith explained the pros and cons of each system with not a hint of pressure selling.Identifying some shading issues we decided on the Qcells panels, SolarEdge Inverter and optimizers.Installation team arrived on scheduled time and completed the installation same day (34 panels, 2 story).The team (5 guys) were terrific, excellent job and mannerism.Independent electrical inspection was booked; happening tomorrow and I am sure that is will pass with no issues.I am very please so far and all indications suggest that I have made the right choice.

Green Sky was responsive and professional throughout the sales, but to be fair so were the other installers I received quotes from. What set Green Sky apart was that I had more confidence that they were trying to quote the best system for my needs. For example, unlike others Keith advised against squeezing extra panels onto every available roof space as the cost of the additional racking, wiring etc would outweigh the increased production. In addition after they quoted and responded to my questions, Green Sky left me alone, unlike others who constantly (exhaustingly) followed up daily. Installation went smoothly after some unavoidable lockdown and weather-related delays. (One of the installers stayed back after the installation was complete to help an elderly neighbour fix their driveway gate which was kind of nice too.)
The team at Green Sky Solar were very helpful and answered all my questions.

I was recommended this installer by a work colleague and went ahead with a quote. At the same time I requested competitive quotations from other suppliers. Green Sky provided a quote said any queries come back to us. The other companies started pushy sales techniques such as ringing up badgering me and emailing saying when are you going ahead, threating price increases etc. Green Sky when I went back to them with a few queries modified the layout etc and made suggestions for a overall good consultation. We went ahead with Green Sky and they made the whole sale painless and organised installation a few weeks later.The installation the electricians were very good and did a excellent job and even the inspector said he was even impressed by the standard of workmanship. Overall I would recommend Green Sky for your solar installation.

All round, a great team at Green Sky. Keith the Solar expert, Narelle the Customer Service Manager provided all the  tech info, grid forms, prompt emails/documents to sign etc. The install team were fun guys who obviously enjoy what they do.
We had a great experience using Green Sky Australia. Expert knowledge. On time on budget with great installation and customer service. Could not fault them

Quote and sales process was transparent. Everything fully explained.Installation was brilliant. Arrived on time, finished within the timeframe promised. No mess, no fuss.After sales service was outstanding. All connections and paperwork completed within days of completion, inverter connected to my network, networking of the system and grid connection done straight away.

I found the sales team at Green Sky to be helpful and informative without being pushy.  The price offered was very competitive.Green Sky were more than efficient in the installation process - they were actually able to bring the installation date forward.  Despite a dismal day, the installers completed the process with a minimum of fuss and left the site clean and tidy.  Follow up to date has been excellent.

There was a considerable time lapse between accepting my quote, to the actual installation.  This was due to the Covid-19 restrictions.   During this period, I was kept informed on the future installation date and any changes due to Victorian Government requirements along the way.  The Green Sky installer was punctual and efficient with a wealth of knowledge.  All in all, I was very happy with the customer service Green Sky Australia offered, including ensuring my grid connection after installation.

Keith inspected the property and his advice was most helpful, which included advising the switch board needed upgrading - it was 40 years old. The quote was timely and competitive. The decision was made to increase the original 6.66 kW system to 8.88 kW. Panel layout was changed several times and always accepted by Keith with grace. The hardware selected was 24 x 370W Jinko panels and Enphase microinverters. Due to afternoon shadowing, the final layout of one array of eleven panels required four landscape and seven portrait, to maximise the generation.The two installers, John and Andrew arrived on schedule. The installation was during lockdown, which meant the roof space could not be accessed. Despite this, only one conduit had to be run. All other wiring was concealed by lifting roofing iron and ridge capping, and the result was beyond our expectations. The position of the landscape panels required extra framing timber to secure the upper rails, which was carried out skilfully. This was a challenging installation, but John and Andrew worked without a break to complete it within the day, and then tidied up the site.The installation was on Monday last week, and the inspection was on Thursday. Green Sky have organised the grid connection, and we now await the retailer to complete it.I would recommend Green Sky Australia to any potential customer without hesitation.

I had wanted to get solar panels for a while, and while cost was a factor, just knowing who to choose and going through the gauntlet of the various suppliers just put me off.  I ended up with Green Sky for a couple of reasons, mainly because they were local suppliers and their salesperson Keith was always happy to answer any queries without pressure.  I did a comparison to 4 - 5 other suppliers too.  I did find the ones that advertise extensively on TV, very pushy once they had your details.  Green Sky were not the cheapest but they were not the most expensive either.  I had the confidence to go with them because of the components they use and no-pressure.Keith was very good explaining the panels and inverters they supply and which system was best for me.  I ended up with 10kw Q-Cells and a Fronius 8 KW inverter.  I also qualified for the $1,850 Solar Vic rebate which was nice.  Installation took a day, and the two guys who did the install were very neat, and packed up all the packaging before they left.  I did have to follow-up with the grid connection as my provider expects this done via their website, and not sending in forms, but once I queried this with Green Sky, they sorted it out quickly.Installation was July, full connection to the grid was August, so my first full month feeding back into the grid was only the September billing. My last two power bills prior to solar panels was approx $300 per month.  My September bill was only $74, so less than a quarter of what I used to pay per month!  And this is in Melbourne with our not always pleasant Spring weather. Can't wait for summer! I have a north facing roof with no over shadowing so on a sunny day I'm getting great performance.  Even on an overcast day, I'm still generating power.So far, so very good.

From Keith visiting site and getting up on the roof to take readings with a meter to accurately design the PV panel layout, to the installation by Brad and his Apprentice Mitch, and the electrical inspection/paperwork, there is nothing I could fault with Greensky Solar.Brad an Mitch did a sensational job at the install, neat and safe work, and this is coming from a fellow Electrician(Customer) who is very picky about neat electrical work.The electrical inspection was exactly a week after completion of installation. Up and running in a week, unreal.Paperwork went in to my energy provider quickly as well.Keren and Matt in the Office, along with Keith the sales guy were great to deal with, answering all my queries along the journey.The best part, the system is generating over 20kWh power most days(in September in Melbourne) and charging those batteries for night time use. On the best days, it has generated 34kWh. I am also exporting power on most sunny days. I will be possibly adding 2 more 3.5kWh batteries, once I get some data on production vs usage/feed in to grid.I will be recommending Greensky to my friends who want Solar. Would do so for anyone on Solarquotes too.

It must be noted that the whole exercise was carried out  during the COVID 19, so this certainly made things more difficult for Green Sky, but they coped well to get it installed as soon as possible without breaking any rules.I chose Green Sky because I think they best understood my needs and came up with the most suitable configuration with 22 panels and Solar Edge inverter.. Their proposal was very straightforward and honest.I recognised at the outset  ( having spoken to friends who have installed solar) that roof tile breakage is a potential problem. I did not want to have broken or "repaired" roof tiles. So I bought a pallet of 24 tiles to have on hand as replacements. As it transpired, they used most of them, ie, about 1 breakage per solar panel. None of the suppliers, including Green Sky, quoted in a cost element for this ( worth about $70) or adequately warned of the risk.I have since been up on the roof myself because of a different matter and noticed about half a dozen of the broken tiles had been left lying around on the garage roof ( which is a separate flat steel roof) out of sight. Such a small  thing, but sloppy and thus the loss of 1 star.Also, the installation required temporary safety barriers be put up on the roof for the duration of the job. This was done by a separate firm sub-contracting to Green Sky. I was given no previous advice of this and little notice of these people turning up. When the installation was completed they obviously turned up and removed them, but I was not told about this in advance, so one day the barriers are there and the next day they are not. Again, this is a small issue but really it is poor communication. This also contributes to the loss of a star.

The whole process with Green Sky was so smooth from the initial on site visit through to start up.Their customer service is amazing and very informative. The installers were prompt and the system looks great.I am certainly enjoying my bills being a third of what they were prior (and it isnt even summer).Would highly recommend.

Brad, Matt and everyone at GreenSky are a knowledgable team to work with. We'd had Keith come give us a quote and considered solar in early 2020 and then pandemic/lockdown pushed everything to the side. We liked his non-pushy, informational approach. GreenSky came around again this year and it turned out that solar + battery was a good proposition for us. Very happy with their flexibility, price point, quality/service and communication.
Great to deal with from start to finish. Installers were professional with an attention to detail.
Green Sky provided prompt and punctual service. Installation was seamless and site left clean.

Keith was great. Explained everything. Quoted on good quality items from the start, not cheap rubbish to make the price look good. Good communication with the office staff. Installation completed when booked and on time. Very happy with the products offered, quoted and installed.

Kept me up to date on progress and informed re the install date. Help prompt me to chase VicSolar to process the application.Arrive on time on a less than ideal day but worked well and completed the installation with no fuss.

Due to COVID, Keith relied on the Google earth view of my home rather than conduct a site inspection, but he was happy to discuss matters at length. Other quotes and discussions from those who had inspected the site, confirmed that Keith's assessment of appropriate positioning was correct, My research also confirmed that the product brands specified were high quality. All other quotes were clearly compromised by inferior brand products specified. The quote was also inclusive of the hire of safety rails needed for installation on a second storey roof,and as the installation of an extra master switch to the power board, in addition to the inverter master switch, because my 1999 power board did not have one at all.The installation team were polite, professional and did a very neat job in positioning the inverter and the wiring. I was advised that once the independent inspector had unlocked the inverter switch, I would be using the power generated, but that the grid connection would take few weeks. Greensky did promptly request a copy of my electricity bill so that they organise the grid connection. A month has passed since installation and it appears that they still do not have the inspector's certificate despite the inspector having unlocked the inverter switch about a week after installation.

We recently used Green Sky after a sudden storm ripped 3 panels from the roof. Keith and his team were amazing. Quality advice, prompt and efficient service, nothing was an issue. They removed the exisiting system, reinstalled it in line with current standards, added a couple of additional panels, diagnosed a controller issue we weren't even aware of, then when there was a couple of hiccups with the configuration, they persevered and sorted out our issue.I cant recommend Keith and the team at Green Sky highly enough. Superb service!!!

The sales and quoting process was quick and easy. The installation was completed in a day and everything worked perfectly. It's been 6 months since the system was installed and there are no issues to report. Very happy with the system.

Keith visited us and was very genuine with his approach - that was they key reason I decided to go with GreenSky. The installation was done on the day. Only one issue was that the consumption monitoring meter brought on the day was the wrong one. Late 2015, Nicholls Solar (Keith Buxton) provided me a comprehensive explanation of the solar PV system that they are recommending.  Aside from me doing my own research about the individual components, Keith provided his own knowledgeable opinion about the systems they install, the quality, any pros and cons, etc.  He personally came over to have a look at the roof layout, and answered most of my questions.  He even suggested delaying the install if I want to have a truly battery storage-ready system that will be available early 2016.  True to his promise, him and his men (Roman and Brad) came to do the install mid-January 2016 and my solar PV system was up and running that day.  There were minor teething problems due to the newness of the component, but Keith, with the help of the OEM, were able to resolve the issue very quickly.  The issue was more web reporting-related (production vs consumption), and nothing to do with the overall install and quality of the solar PV system.Long and short of it - we are very happy with our experience with Nicholls Solar (Victoria) and the system they have recommended.  Looking forward to contacting them again once the battery-storage solution for solar PV systems have matured (and cheaper) in a couple of years, perhaps.
Too early to really comment on this totallyBut so far really happy
As I write, the solar is in, and the air condititioning is due to be installed tomorrow. They are giving me a 'free' switchboard upgrade as part of the deal. Keith is a very knowledgable manager.

2 of the 3 suppliers were really good to deal with, one of the suppliers was a little too concerned with knocking the other suppliers rather than trying to come up with the right solution for the right price

The whole post-install process wasn't really made 100% clear to me.  3 weeks later it still hasn't been turned on yet!  Need to wait like 25 business days for a meter upgrade.Also turns out that electricity companies up your daily supply charge when you're on a solar plan, just for the privilege of allowing me to generate power for them.Nicholls was really good though
Found Nicholls good to deal, good information on choices, delivered as promised with best price for top system, quotes on lesser component systems very competitive as well.

We had an excellent experience and could not fault Nicholls Group in everything they did. I can't recommend them highly enough to be honest. I have great faith now that they will help us in future when we expand the system. Wouldn't dream of going anywhere else.

Keith Buxton from the Nicholls Group is an absolute pleasure to deal with. He is an honest and upfront individual, he spent the time to fully inform me of our options and answered my many questions about the technology and about the industry in general.  In the end, we chose to go with the Nicholls Group because the point of difference was the way in which Keith educated us about the system rather than "selling" us a system.
Nice salesman , good service, all done in 3 weeks !Prices are about some with two other supplies.

I chose micro inverters despite extra cost because of tricky roof layout and some shading from trees and neighbour's house. Supplier was very helpful and patient with questions and supply of information. Punctual and efficient with appointments and workmanship. Had to complete job over a second day because of windy conditions.Panels all working well and producing even on cloudy days it seems!  Now connected for refunds for surplus energy, but no bill yet. Can recommend this company. Looking forward to air con over hot summer!

Right from the outset Keith was most interested in selecting and designing the best system for my needs and roof orientation and not trying to overspecify the system. Their pricing for the premium system was also very competitively priced. The installers were very respectful of my house during the installation and worked extra long and hard to ensure the inverter location was where I wanted it and the cabling was hidden minimising the need for external conduits.
Found Keith very down to earth installed as he said he would his installation crew very nice , efficient  and knowledgeable and finished in a very timely manner, no problems in recommending him
This three quote process made things so easy.  The companies chosen all knew there would be other quotes to come, so I didn't have the salesman pressuring me to sign on the spot.

Keith provided clear quotes, using good components for reasonable prices.  The installation went well but I did have trouble getting the enphase monitoring unit working well.  It struggles to get good signal levels even from the room next to the switchboard and when we put it on one circuit it caused my bedside lamp to keep switching on and off.  We finally found a place for it and it generally seems to work there.  However, the actual panels appear to be working fine.

With Nicholls Group you will get no pressure sales tatics, polite, knowledgeable and great after sales service.   Sales consultant/Director provides excellent after sales service.  He returned to check installation as requested and provides same day or next day response to my emails.  The installers were capable and polite and clean up after themselves with no mess left behind.  My experience with the solar installation is great as my solar system works from day one.   I am waiting for the electricity  retailer and supplier to connect me to the grid.

Keith was incredible.  He came with a non-sales approach, and provided really good information and pricing.He responded to all of my questions, and offered a really great deal as well with enphase microinverters, and great warranty terms.Superb quality installation - very clean and tidy.They did not mark the walls moving panels to the roof.  They did not cause any damage of any sort, and even ran the cables inside the wall internally as far as possible, and the electrical conduit in an inconspicuous location externally.I could not be more pleased.I have already recommended them to others.A++++

Nicholls were very good to deal with; they did everything that you expect, promptly, efficiently, and courteously.  There was a call a few days ahead to arrange time for the work, the guys turned up precisely when they were supposed to. They were friendly and polite, but very business like and efficient.  Workmanship is good, and they cleaned up afterwards.  After completion I had a follow up call to make sure everything was happy.  I'd recommend them.
reviews.panel_brand: Don't know, can't be bothered looking. (Other)

reviews.review_description: Great company with good service.  Provided all of the information up front.  Gave expert advice and able to back up claims with good evidence.  Happy to spend time answering questions and giving advice.  Efficient, fast service on installation day.  Happy to work on your behalf regarding warranty claims etc in the future.  No pressure sales tactics.

I was also very impressed with the salesperson and system proposed by Solargain and would have been happy to have them install a system. However Nicholls Solar quoted a better price for exactly the system specification. The system installation was prompt, efficient and without fuss. After sales service by Nicholls has been excellent. There was an issue with the online monitoring system and Nicholls attended my system to check all connections and also set up the Envoy gateway hub.

I wanted a top quality 2.5 kW system on my small roof and Nicholls' suggested a 10 Q-Cell panel configuration I was happy with instead of just offering me a 9 panel system. They were the only ones to quote using the Enphase M215 microinverter, that were a few hundred dollars more than the SMA string inverter I originally wanted. After factoring the possibility of having to replace the inverter after 10 years, the micro-inverters were a no-brainer.  To (hopefully) ensure greater inverter durability, I requested the higher power handling Enphase M250, which Nicholls were happy to supply.Ray was patient throughout the quote process and came back a second time with Keith to confirm the configuration that I was happy with. My installation was delayed due to rain and Nicholls did the best they could to work around it and my schedule. On the installation day, I was surprised and delighted at the effort Keith and Roman made to ensure a very neat and tidy installation.The system has so far performed to my satisfaction and I am happy to recommend Nicholls to anyone that wants a quality solar installation.

System was installed 1/4/15 and United energy reconfigured our smart meter 2/6/15 thus making the installation complete after 2 months. A delay of around a week in final completion was due to the installer failing to tick a box on the EWR and having an illegible name on the PV Generator Connection Form. Lumo Energy was very particular regarding paperwork.

The other two companies were pretty useless.  One made 2 appointments to come over and didn't turn up.  The other wouldn't even make an appointment as we needed to wait three months before we could install.Keith has been very helpful and came up with a way to make sure we had enough panels facing north.  He explained all our options and didn't push us to go with something more expensive.  He actually listened to our needs.  That's a rare quality.

We didn't like the high pressure sales pitch of Gryphon. "just sign here, you can always pull out in the cooling off period". They found it hard to accept we were prepared to pay more for a better system.We liked the care taken by Nicholls to have us choose micro-inverters to cope with possible shade on some of the panels. (Our system is actually 2.5 KW.)The two installers were great. The electrician (Roy) was excellent. The process to get hooked up to the grid through Dodo took only three weeks.The $5,600 for ten panels with micro-inverters seems good value to us, but we are not doing it to save money; it is a gesture to reduce our carbon emissions, in spite of our government's love-affair with coal.

No hidden extras which seems like a bonus in this day and age.The sales team and installation crew were all a pleasure to deal withA couple of small site issues were dealt with as if they didn't exist.Couldn't be happier
It was relatively painless.  The company contacted me the day before to remind me on the installation.  The installers arrived on time and completed the works within the time frame specified.
The best quote using the best German inverter (Sunnyboy) and top performing panels.

You generally get what you pay for, so I got quotes for Tier One panels, the best quality inverters available, and a quality installation. I quickly got an idea of what it would reasonably cost and just as I was making my decision Nicholls published a Christmas sale price that couldn't be beaten.
So far so good, waiting for the inspector to give final ok and then we have to wait for my power company to give the ok, have been told from day off installation it can take up to 10 weeks

I spoke to a number of friends who have solar and asked them if they would recommend the solar company that they used.  None did.  Having used Nicholls Solar, I would be more than happy to recommend them to any person interested in investigating solar.  They were informative, flexible and very well priced.Similarly, not having looked into solar before, I found the service of the Solarquotes website extremely beneficial.  The said that they would identify 3 companies to contact me within 48 hours and all 3 did contact in less than 36 hours.  Appointments were promptly made and all arrived for their appointment on time which was a surprise in itself.  I have been more than satisfied with SolarQuotes and their affiliated solar installation companies.

2 of 3 solar quotes suppliers responded.  I got 2 other quotations.  I work overseas so everything was done via email.  Selected Nicholls based on best service - not best price.  Keith was very good and responded to my many queries.

If you want to do a solar 'proper job':1. Research, research, and them do some more research.2. Your Electricity retailer will make many many mistakes (always in their favour) and waste a lot of your time, so you must keep on top of them. Log all calls.3. The Ombudsman is your best friend.4. My distributer (AusNet) was very efficient and most helpful.I am very happy with my system setup.
Fantastic to see a real electrician attend and explain all the ins and outs of solar power.  We felt very comfortable dealing with Keith.

I had read reviews on your site.  People need to be ready for long delays.  This was not the installer, Keith was fantastic: informative and friendly.  He was very organised, the installation went very smoothly and quickly.The delays were SP Ausnet, nearly 6 weeks to approve the size of the system, and SP Ausnet/Red Energy to organise the new billing, feed in, etc.  Someone, apparently, had to come our to reprogramme the newly installed smart meter.  From finish of installation to accessing the electricity grid was 3 months.We use Apple computers so the inverter won't send information to them, we purchased a Sunny Boy desk monitor (about $400) to keep an eye on the performance.

I cannot rate this company any higher than A+ from the get go. Right from explaining the system specs and data to me rather than trying to sell me the system.Customer service was 5 Star right through the process. The installers were informative, careful, thorough and professional.For a reasonably large investment I could not be any happier with my system and installation.Nicholls Solar Well Recommended 5 Star.

Of the three quotes we obtained (four, including our electricity provider Origin), Keith at Nicholls provided by far the most knowledgeable and convincing response to our enquiry. He gave the clear impression that he was interested in providing us with the solar system that suited us best, and provided us with  convincing answers to our questions. Installation was also very good -- we have a tiled roof and the installers broke a few tiles on the day, but Keith ensured these were promptly replaced. The system has been up and working for a few months and we are very pleased with the significant reduction in our electricity costs. We would recommend Nicholls group very highly.

Having done my due diligence on solar systems I found Nicholls Solar Melbourne came up with the system I wanted and of course the price. I found Nicholls Solar Melbourne to be very informative, professional and had my system installed in a matter of weeks. The tradies where very professionaland knew what they were doing. All in all very happy with my system and Nicholls Solar Melbourne.

Solar installation went smooth and within week of quote units were installed.The main problem is the after installation. Our installation was completed on 24/10, inspection completed by 31/10, today Nov 27th we are still waiting for distributor and retailer to do their part so as we can finally get the panels to work.On calling Energy Australia we did find that Nicholls Group had sent the forms to wrong email address and that a pre approval form had not been sent at all. Nicholls responded and sent within a day. Energy Australia advised that all forms have now been received and there will be 8 weeks for them to complete our connection etc, that was a fortnight ago
Prompt and no fuss. Easy to access after the installation with questions too.  I would certainly recommend.

From our acceptance of the offer to the installation and connection took a matter of four weeks. A truly seamless exercise. The installers left the home and you wouldn't have known they'd been here. The system is installed and operative.

The installers did a fantastic fit out and made sure our electrical switchboard was in tip top condition.After they'd left you would never know they'd been here at all. Complete professionals. We are now extremely thankful we chose the Nicholls Group as our Solar supplier.

Nicholls were the only company who were actually positive about my situation in a block of flats, they always got back to me, and we worked out a schedule and they stuck by their quote, even though they were booked up for quite a while. They never left me in the dark.The other two companies I contacted had to be prompted to call me back, one was extremely negative about my having to get permission from a body corp and both wouldn't even quote until they had room in their installation schedules several months later. By which time I had already signed up with Nicholls.
Very professional. Installation and hook up to grid done quickly. All done in a few weeks. Finn's website was invaluable. Thanks
To be highly recommended.
Still not operational, it is a pain chasing up retailers etc. for final steps.

It is really too early to accurately complete some aspects of this survey. I am very happy with the installation but cannot yet establish the quality and value for money of the system, hence my average (non committal) ratings for value and quality.I did my research and think I picked the best system for my purposes but only time will tell! I have already noticed, however, that a 3kW system is only producing a peak of just over 2kW. Further research seems to indicate that this is about all I can expect.I especially appreciated Nicholls' provision of three system options and excellent quote documentation.
They installed my solar system and my ducted air conditioner both jobs were done very neat Keith is very professional and was with the job from start to finish. I highly recomened him to anyone
Installation went well but I am not sure about the remote monitoring.  The CD provided is very confusing and doesn't provide enough information to work out how to use the system.
Three weeks since installation and I am still waiting for the inspector to check the work!!!

The guys at Nicholls Solar Vic were helpful, reliable, and flexible. Their premium system quote was extremely competitive. They turned up when they said they would, cleaned up after themselves, and continued to provide information and assistance after the installation was complete and the invoice paid. Power output from the 3.5kW system is exceeding expectations.

Everyone who quotes says their panels and inverter is best. Who do you believe?I chose a company who have been in business for a long time, who came to site and measured the roof area available rather than quoting off a google map,who answered all my questions, and who used their own employees to install the system.Getting the PV system inspected and paperwork sorted with the electricity retailer and distributor seems to take an inordinate amount of time.
Disinterested salesperson but the installer was superb onsite!
Nicholls was the only one that contacted us.

I ordered my system before the 31 December 2012 and expected to pick up feed-in tariffs as of that date. However, it appears that the retailer considers that my system became operational after that date and therefore I cannot benefit from any thing greater than  a feed in tariff of 8 cents/kilowatt hour.The state government is pathetic towards the solar power industry. I can only hope that there is a future for the likes of people who purchase solar generators systems.

Overall, I am very happy with my QCells & Samil MMPT Inverter recommended by Nicholls Solar Melbourne. The 2 other installers you recommended however weren't much help at all especially Mark groups rep for my area who provided misleading info and attempted to give me a system that was totally inappropriate.I found your Website info excellent it was without biased and believe me I DID my research.  It was a Major component of my decision making process and would and will recommend it to others.
The installer was Mr. Keith Buxton. He explained everything and was very polite. I have no hesitation in recommending him.
As the system has only just been checked by the inspector, we are not able to comment about customer service.

Like many others who have had solar installed, I discovered after the install that many roof tiles had been broken during the installation process.  I have since had to replace many tiles at my expense.

Company was the only one who found no problems with the installation site. They were very good at explanations on what was needed and why, and did the installation with absolutely no mess, fuss or bothers of any kind. Can't recommend them highly enough.

From start to complete installation, the service from Keith Buxton from Nicholls group has been absolutely top quality throughout.The Nicholls group uses only top quality materials throughout.I am most pleased with the service, behavior and helpful follow-up assistance from this agent including his contact with my supplier re setting up and connection to the grid. He was the only contact to come to my home for an inspection and quote for the complete job.There was no pressure applied to achieve a signature accepting a contract on the spot. He allowed time for me to digest all the details before making up my mind to go ahead.I have no hesitation in recommending him to any prospective purchaser of solar energy.
Installation was quickly done. I had good post-installation correspondence to expedite the document process. My questions were answered promptly.

Keith was fantastic.  He supplied an email quote as asked,  unlike other companies.   He visited himself offered options of different panels and inverters.   Installation was done quickly in a day no problems.   Installers were good.   Paperwork was submitted ASAP to power company.   Keith always answered the phone and emails he could not be more helpful.    A bit dearer than the cheap companies but well worth it.   Highly recommended could not fault the company.
As above.

Keith delivered a very informative and unbiased explanation face to face, which answered all my queries.There was no hard sell, unlike one other supplier, and the installation team were on time, courteous and professional in their approach.I would easily recommend Nicholls Group Melbourne to anyone considering purchasing a Solar System.The sales representative from Madison Group called me to book a  site visit, but did not arrive on the day at the scheduled appointment time, very annoying as I had taken time off work, and did not return any of my phone calls!!!  I am yet to hear from them??

Highly recommended.  From initial advice to installation and after installation advice.  Very happy we chose Nicholls Solar.Waited 4 months to write this review as I was waiting for first power bill to confirm all connection fees were covered as stated in the quote and that there were no issues with the installation and product.  Power bill arrived today and all connection fees were paid for and the system hasn't missed a beat.
I highly recommend Nicholls solar. The salesperson made the effort to come to my home and discuss details with me. Very professional and informative.

All contacts with the company were handled promptly and efficiently. Keith was very knowledgeable and gave us lots of information to help make a decision. We liked the fact that all costs and work were covered in their quote and that the same person was to be quoting and installing the system. As it turned out he had a death in the family and had co-workers do the installation but came out afterwards to double check everything was done to his satisfaction.

Hi Finn! Firstly, a big thanks to you for sending the solar quotes to me!  To my delight I found the best quote and most reliable installers that I could! To top it off, the transaction was hassle & stress free! :o) To see the electric meter running backwards was a rare experience indeed, making money with the solar panels was pure magic!Keith Buxton & his offsider Roman, worked hard & they were both friendly & efficient, in all aspects of the big job that faced them. Once I received the quotes I still did not decide for a few weeks, then Nicholls solar had a promotion with a free solar panel upgrade. Have been researching quite a few Companies and their Solar system they provide. Found Nicholls Groups through Finn Peacock's help.
